visualCharacteristics.purpose: US state map with click-to-show sales representatives
visualCharacteristics.layout: Clickable US map with hover highlight, tooltip and rep panel

contentPattern.structure: intro row: map image + h2 + intro paragraphs; then one row per rep: photo | name, phone, email paragraphs | list of states (optional bracketed note)

reuseGuidance: Reuse rep-locator for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
